verdict.rationale: Cubic is a SaaS AI code-review product, and whether its source is published under an open license is a fair question for any software product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a public repository, open-source license, or source availability. The docs describe only hosted review features, a CLI and an MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
